title: Governed reads: confinement at the open, and who may perform one
note: The read boundary. Every mutation here removes exactly one thing standing between an authorized NAME and unauthorized BYTES. The ones that matter most are R2 (a symlinked parent directory moves a whole subtree somewhere the authority never named), R3 (without O_NONBLOCK a substituted FIFO turns a bounded read into an indefinite hang rather than a refusal), and R14 (the read bytes reach the audit log, which is exactly how a secret would get there).

mutations.name: R1_leaf_open_follows_symlinks
mutations.rationale: a symlink at the leaf is followed, so an authorized name delivers bytes from wherever the link points

mutations.name: R2_intermediate_open_follows_symlinks
mutations.rationale: a symlinked PARENT moves the whole subtree outside the root while every leaf name still looks correct

mutations.name: R3_open_can_block_on_a_fifo
mutations.rationale: a substituted named pipe turns a bounded read into an indefinite hang, which is a denial of service that looks like a slow disk

mutations.name: R4_opened_object_type_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a pipe, device or directory is read as though it were a file; the pathname was checked and the OBJECT was not

mutations.name: R5_size_bound_removed
mutations.rationale: an unbounded read: a large file exhausts memory before anything notices

mutations.name: R6_growth_during_read_ignored
mutations.rationale: a file that grows while being read escapes the bound the size check established

mutations.name: R7_traversal_allowed
mutations.rationale: '..' climbs out of the authorized root, which is the oldest path attack there is

mutations.name: R8_absolute_paths_allowed
mutations.rationale: an absolute path is a request to leave the root, and it is accepted

mutations.name: R9_digest_expectation_ignored
mutations.find: if expect_digest is not None and dg != expect_digest:
mutations.rationale: content substitution stops being detected: the only defence that survives an attacker who wins the pre-open race

mutations.name: R10_no_capabilities_means_allow
mutations.rationale: default DENY becomes default allow -- a reader holding nothing reads everything

mutations.name: R11_capability_not_checked
mutations.rationale: any capability id authorizes any read, including one issued to another actor for another task

mutations.name: R12_path_not_validated_before_the_grant
mutations.rationale: a traversal attempt is reported as a scope miss instead of a traversal, sending an operator to the wrong problem

mutations.name: R13_denials_are_not_recorded
mutations.find:
self._record(req, capability_id, allowed=False,
                         reason=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
            raise
        try:
mutations.rationale: 'what did this agent try to read' has no answer, which is the question an incident starts with

mutations.name: R14_the_bytes_are_written_to_the_log
mutations.rationale: the content of every governed read lands in the audit trail; a read is exactly how a secret would get there

mutations.name: R15_read_scope_loses_its_root_namespace
mutations.find: return tuple(f"{root_id}/{p.lstrip('/')}" for p in paths)
mutations.replace: return tuple(p.lstrip('/') for p in paths)
mutations.rationale: a grant scoped to one root becomes spendable against another that happens to share a relative path

mutations.name: R16_evidence_reads_by_pathname_again
mutations.rationale: the store reopens by NAME after the confined open, reintroducing the whole window and losing the digest check with it

mutations.name: R17_evidence_stops_binding_to_the_digest
mutations.rationale: the store returns whatever is filed under the name without checking it hashes back to it: layout becomes evidence

mutations.name: R18_verification_stops_binding_to_the_cited_digest
mutations.rationale: verification confirms that a file EXISTS rather than that it is the file the task cited

mutations.name: R19_verification_uses_the_executors_grant
mutations.rationale: the executor's authority becomes what permits the check on its own work, which is the shape separation of duties exists to forbid

mutations.name: R20_hard_link_alias_accepted
mutations.rationale: a second hard link -- another name for the same bytes, possibly outside the root entirely -- stops being refused even where the caller asked for unique identity

mutations.name: R21_verification_stops_requiring_a_unique_name
mutations.rationale: a governed artifact may be reachable by a name no authority saw, and verification confirms it anyway
